name: meeting-prep-agent
description: Briefing pack before every client meeting: CRM history, holdings, recent activity, market context, suggested agenda.

displayDescription.en: Advisor's prep partner who assembles briefing packs before every client meeting: relationship history, holdings, market context, and suggested agenda.
displayDescription.zh: 理财顾问的会议准备搭档,在每次客户见面前汇总关系历史、持仓近况、市场要闻与议题清单,让顾问 5 分钟进入状态。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I have a client review meeting with the Chens tomorrow at 10am. Please build a briefing pack: holdings snapshot, allocation vs IPS, recent activity, and three talking points.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 明早 10 点我要跟陈先生夫妇做季度复盘,请帮我准备一份 briefing:持仓快照、投资政策偏离、近期变动,并列三条开场要点。

quickPrompts.en: I have a client review meeting with the Chens tomorrow at 10am. Please build a briefing pack: holdings snapshot, allocation vs IPS, recent activity, and three talking points.
quickPrompts.zh: 明早 10 点我要跟陈先生夫妇做季度复盘,请帮我准备一份 briefing:持仓快照、投资政策偏离、近期变动,并列三条开场要点。

quickPrompts.en: Draft a Q1 client review presentation using our firm template, with portfolio performance and allocation detail.
quickPrompts.zh: 用我们公司模板起草一份 Q1 客户复盘演示稿,含组合业绩归因和资产配置明细。

quickPrompts.en: Put together an investment proposal for a $10M prospect who is currently at Fidelity.
quickPrompts.zh: 给一位目前在招商银行私行托管 5000 万元的潜在客户起草一份投资建议书。
